name: expansion
gotchas: `mat-accordion`'s `multi` input defaults to `false`, meaning expanding one panel automatically collapses any other open panel in the same accordion — set `multi` explicitly if panels should expand independently.

`mat-panel-title`/`mat-panel-description` are always rendered, but a panel's body wrapped in `<ng-template matExpansionPanelContent>` is lazy-instantiated only after the panel's first expansion by default — use that template for expensive content instead of putting it directly inside `mat-expansion-panel`.

Toggling `[expanded]` programmatically in the same tick as `ngAfterViewInit` (e.g. to auto-open a panel on load) can throw `ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError` — set the initial expanded state from a component property before the view renders instead of mutating it in a lifecycle hook.
